## PulseNet
PulseNet is a fabric port-ish of the cutting-edge network optimization PaperMC fork called [Pulse](https://pulsemc.dev/).
Long story short, it is a server-sided mod that significantly reduces network lag that is caused by having to send thousands of packets from things like particles (Arcana is very guilty of this), large amounts of entities, as well as massive block updates from explosions.
**Let the results speak for themselves, PulseNet should reduce your server's network lag by 90% - 99.9%, and shave a couple % of your CPU usage in the process.**
